sentences.en: It's not what you wear, it's how you wear it.
sentences.zh: 1. 不在于你穿什么，而在于你怎么穿。

sentences.en: It is unusual to see rock stars wearing a tie!
sentences.zh: 2. 看到摇滚明星系领带还挺不常见的！

sentences.en: Girls wearing mini-skirts, walking or sitting, are very effective eye-openers.
sentences.zh: 3. 穿着迷你裙的女孩走起路来或坐着的时候非常引人注目。
